Continue with the planned training session today, focusing on threshold efforts to improve uphill economy and long-duration performance. Ensure adequate recovery between sessions, prioritizing sleep and HRV to support continued aerobic development.
Maintain a consistent weekly routine, including a mix of easy, threshold, and long sessions, to build aerobic durability and resilient trail-running capacity.
Monitor sleep duration and quality closely, aiming for 7-8 hours per night. Aim for a consistent bedtime and wake-up time to support optimal recovery.
Consider incorporating active recovery days, such as short, easy runs or yoga, to further enhance recovery and prevent overtraining syndrome.
Keep a log of your training sessions and recovery practices to identify patterns and areas for improvement. This will help you fine-tune your approach as you progress.
